stories.story_fr: Reinsurance Solutions affiche une croissance organique de 8% au T4 2025, portee par les placements de traites et une forte retention, confirmant le segment comme le moteur de croissance organique le plus dynamique d'Aon.
stories.story_en: Reinsurance Solutions posted 8% organic revenue growth in Q4 2025, driven by treaty placements and strong retention, confirming the segment as Aon's most dynamic organic growth engine.
stories.quote: Reinsurance Solutions Organic revenue growth of 8%

stories.story_fr: Au T1 2026, Commercial Risk Solutions accelere a 7% de croissance organique, tiree par une croissance a deux chiffres en Amerique du Nord et une forte progression en EMEA, sur fond de demande client croissante.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, Commercial Risk Solutions accelerated to 7% organic growth, driven by double-digit growth in North America and strong growth in EMEA amid rising client demand.
stories.quote: Organic revenue growth of 7% reflects double-digit growth in North America and strong growth in EMEA, driven by net new business

stories.story_fr: Aon execute sa strategie Aon United via le Plan 3x3 pour repondre a la demande croissante de solutions integrees combinant expertise, donnees et analytique a grande echelle aupres des clients mondiaux et du middle-market.
stories.story_en: Aon is executing its Aon United strategy through the 3x3 Plan to meet rising demand for integrated solutions combining expertise, data and analytics at scale among global and middle-market clients.
stories.quote: We continue to execute our Aon United strategy through the 3x3 Plan to meet rising client demand

stories.story_fr: Aon a annonce le 10 avril 2026 une hausse de 10% de son dividende trimestriel, sa sixieme augmentation annuelle a deux chiffres consecutive, signe de la solidite de sa generation de flux de tresorerie.
stories.story_en: On April 10, 2026, Aon announced a 10% increase to its quarterly dividend, the sixth consecutive double-digit annual increase, reflecting the strength of its free cash flow generation.
stories.signal: 6e hausse annuelle a deux chiffres du dividende
stories.quote: We announced a 10% increase to the quarterly dividend on April 10, the sixth consecutive double-digit annual increase

stories.story_fr: Wealth Solutions ralentit nettement, a seulement 1% de croissance organique au T1 2026, la croissance se limitant a la Retraite et a la demande de conseil au Royaume-Uni, ce qui en fait le segment le plus faible d'Aon.
stories.story_en: Wealth Solutions slowed markedly to just 1% organic growth in Q1 2026, with growth limited to Retirement and UK advisory demand, making it Aon's weakest segment.
stories.quote: Organic revenue growth of 1% reflects growth in Retirement, driven by continued demand for advisory work in the UK
